evidence.quote: Foreign LLC Filing Filing Fees Secretary of State: $150.00
File two original copies of the "Foreign Limited Liability Company Application for Registration" with the Business Entities Division of the Secretary of State.
Name of registered agent for service of process (MUST be physically located in Alabama)
convenience fees (these fees are 3% of the total charge plus $2.00)

notes: A name reservation certificate from the Alabama Secretary of State must be attached to the application, and the registered agent must be physically located in Alabama. Root states.json carries annual_report_fee 0 for Alabama; this record makes no annual-report claim.
